sourceChecks.text: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ウリヤの死を報告するたとえの中で、エルバアルの子アビメレクとテベツでの死を述べる。
